# Browser media metadata dependency

`jsmediatags-3.9.7.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from the
`jsmediatags` npm package, version 3.9.7. It is loaded only when the persistent
player opens an audio file and reads the title, artist, album, and embedded
picture tags.
